Given Omega's format: 233.32.41.21.01.001: 233 = Seamaster 300, 32 = steel (3) + leather strap (2), 41 = 41mm, 21 = movement (co-axial master?), 01 = black dial, 001.

So reference: 233.32.41.21.01.001. Bracelet material leather, case steel, movement automatic.
